note: Heal the freeze — Kirk 2026-07-27: mom's Chat and Garden AI locked on 'AI is thinking...' after our v5.79.14→18 ships, on a computer that was working fine before. Two things fixed together: (1) TIGHTENED PROMPTS — v5.79.14 nearly doubled the base prompt with censorship text, v5.79.18 rewrote it longer in Covenant voice; combined with auto-injected extensions (Depth, Continuity, Gift, Mind, Threshold, Care Voices — ~1500 tokens), the system prompt could exceed a small Ollama model's default 2048-token context, causing empty response or hang. DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT and HONEST_PREFIX kept in Covenant voice with all four beliefs, tightened ~60% (~2200→~880 chars for DEFAULT, ~900→~460 for HONEST). Full verbatim prompts still on systemcard.html. (2) DEFENSIVE TIMEOUTS — even with tight prompts, no request should be able to hang forever. AbortController with 90s hard limit on the chat fetch (initial + both retry paths). 45s stream-idle timeout on the SSE reader (stalled mid-stream can't freeze the tab). 120s watchdog on setStreamingStatus (belt-and-suspenders: if any code path forgets to clear the state, a friendly toast fires). setStreamingStatus wrapped in defensive DOM-null checks so a missing element can't propagate as an unhandled exception.
